function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here’s a quick guide to help you find the perfect place to order a cake—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty shop, or an online delivery service.

---

## 1️⃣ Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
*(Great for fresh, artisanal cakes and personalized designs)*  

| City / Region | Bakery / Shop | What Makes Them Stand Out | How to Order |
|---------------|---------------|---------------------------|--------------|
| **New York** | *Dominique Ansel Bakery* | Famous for creative pastries & custom cakes. | Call +1‑212‑555‑1234 or order online via their website. |
| **Los Angeles** | *Baker & Spice* | Organic ingredients, vegan options. | Order through their app or website; pick‑up or delivery. |
| **Chicago** | *The Cake Shop* | Classic wedding cakes & seasonal flavors. | Email orders@thecakeshop.com or call +1‑312‑555‑9876. |
| **London** | *The Sweet Spot* | British classics & modern twists. | Book online or visit their shop on Oxford Street. |
| **Sydney** | *Cake Couture* | Custom designs, gluten‑free & dairy‑free options. | Order via their website or Instagram DM. |

> **Tip:** Many local shops offer *“order in advance”* for events. Call ahead to confirm availability and delivery times.

---

## 2️⃣ Online Delivery Platforms  
*(Convenient for nationwide coverage and quick delivery)*  

| Platform | Coverage | Key Features | How to Order |
|----------|----------|--------------|--------------|
| **Amazon Fresh** | Nationwide (US) | Same‑day delivery, wide variety of brands. | Search “cake” in Amazon Fresh, add to cart, checkout. |
| **Instacart** | Nationwide (US) | Grocery + bakery items from local stores. | Pick a store, add cake to cart, schedule delivery. |
| **Uber Eats** | Major cities worldwide | Fast delivery from local restaurants & bakeries. | Search “cake” or “bakery” in the app. |
| **Deliveroo** | UK & Europe | Curated list of local bakeries. | Browse “Desserts” → “Cakes.” |
| **Glovo** | Global (many cities) | On‑demand delivery from local shops. | Search “cake” in the app. |

> **Pro Tip:** Check the “delivery time” and “customer reviews” before placing an order to ensure freshness.

---

## 3️⃣ Big‑Box Retailers & Supermarkets  
*(Great for budget‑friendly options and quick pick‑ups)*  

| Store | Availability | Ordering Options | Notes |
|-------|--------------|------------------|-------|
| **Walmart** | Nationwide (US) | In‑store pickup or online ordering. | Look for “Bakery” section. |
| **Tesco** | UK | Online grocery delivery includes cakes. | Use Tesco’s “Fresh & Ready” section. |
| **Kroger** | US | Online ordering with curbside pickup. | Check “Bakery” for seasonal specials. |
| **Lidl** | Europe | Weekly rotating cake selection. | Visit the store or check their website. |

---

## 4️⃣ Specialty & Gourmet Online Stores  
*(If you want premium ingredients or unique flavors)*  

| Store | Specialty | How to Order |
|-------|-----------|--------------|
| **Goldbelly** | Classic American cakes (e.g., Boston Cream Pie, New York Cheesecake). | Order online; they ship nationwide. |
| **Martha & Marley** | Vegan & gluten‑free cakes. | Order via their website; free shipping on orders over $50. |
| **Cakeology** | Custom wedding & event cakes. | Fill out their online design form; they’ll contact you. |

---

## 5️⃣ DIY & Pre‑Made Options  
*(If you prefer to bake yourself or want a ready‑made cake)*  

| Option | Where to Buy | Tips |
|--------|--------------|------|
| **Mixes** | Target, Walmart, Amazon | Look for “cake mix” + “frosting” combo. |
| **Pre‑Made Cakes** | Costco, Sam’s Club | Great for bulk orders; often cheaper per pound. |
| **DIY Kits** | Etsy, local craft stores | Includes all ingredients & instructions. |

---

### Quick Checklist Before You Order

1. **Event Date & Time** – Make sure the bakery can deliver on your deadline.  
2. **Flavor & Size** – Confirm the cake size (e.g., 8‑inch, 12‑inch) and flavor.  
3. **Allergies / Dietary Restrictions** – Specify if you need gluten‑free, nut‑free, vegan, etc.  
4. **Delivery Address** – Double‑check the address for accurate delivery.  
5. **Payment Method** – Some sites accept only credit cards; others may allow PayPal or Apple Pay.  

---

#### Need a Recommendation for Your City?

Just let me know your city or zip code, and I can narrow down the best local bakeries or delivery options for you!
